_note: Topics and short PubMed strings for the post-meal, post-load and stimulated insulin and C-peptide use-case search; see usecases/POSTPRANDIAL-ADDITIONS-PLAN.md. Read by tools/usecase_search.py. Relevance order, no date window.

topics.topic: Mixed-meal test for suspected reactive (postprandial) hypoglycaemia
topics.query: ("postprandial hypoglycemia" OR "reactive hypoglycemia") AND ("mixed meal" OR "meal test" OR "mixed-meal")

topics.topic: Late dumping syndrome after gastric surgery
topics.query: ("late dumping" OR "dumping syndrome") AND (insulin OR "mixed meal")
("noninsulinoma pancreatogenous hypoglycemia" OR NIPHS OR "adult nesidioblastosis")

topics.topic: OGTT C-peptide to stage type 1 diabetes risk (Index60-type scores)
topics.query: "C-peptide" AND "oral glucose tolerance" AND "type 1 diabetes" AND (progression OR "risk score")

topics.topic: Stimulated C-peptide in LADA to guide treatment
topics.query: LADA AND "C-peptide" AND (stimulated OR "mixed meal") AND (treatment OR insulin)

topics.topic: Glucagon stimulation versus meal test in type 1 diabetes
Protein or leucine challenge in congenital hyperinsulinism
topics.query: "congenital hyperinsulinism" AND (leucine OR "protein challenge" OR "protein-induced" OR "protein load")

topics.topic: Predicting diabetes after pancreatic surgery from a pre-operative OGTT or meal test
topics.query: pancreatectomy AND ("oral glucose tolerance" OR "mixed meal") AND ("C-peptide" OR insulin) AND (diabetes OR "beta-cell")

topics.topic: Meal-test beta-cell function to predict diabetes remission after bariatric surgery
topics.query: bariatric AND "mixed meal" AND "C-peptide" AND remission

topics.topic: Insulinogenic index or OGTT insulin to predict progression in prediabetes
